reply:
Thanks for reaching out, and I'm sorry to hear the annual plan hasn't been a fit so far.

I checked our refund policy: full refunds are available for requests made within 14 calendar days of the charge date. Since your annual charge was 20 days ago, it falls outside that window, so it isn't eligible for a standard refund, and unfortunately we don't offer partial/prorated refunds for unused time on annual plans outside the 14-day window.

That said, requests made after the 14-day window can sometimes be approved as a one-off exception by one of our support managers. I'm escalating your request to a manager for review, and they'll follow up with you directly on next steps. I'm not able to approve or process a refund myself, so I appreciate your patience while it's reviewed.
